api_version_skew.title: ha-spark API versions are incompatible
api_version_skew.description: The ha-spark add-on release {addon_release} speaks API version {addon_api_version} (supported: {addon_supported}). The integration sent API version {integration_api_version} and supports: {supported}. Update the add-on or integration so they support a common API version, then restart the updated half.

confirm.description: Connect the ha-spark add-on to this Home Assistant site?

abort.already_configured: This ha-spark site is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery is not from the ha-spark add-on or contains invalid connection data.
abort.addon_required: ha-spark is set up through its add-on. Install and start the ha-spark add-on: Home Assistant then discovers it and offers it here.
